nom: RoC Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum for Dull Skin & Uneven Skin Tone

segments.oily: One reviewer with normal/combo oily, acne-prone skin reports the serum cleared acne scarring without causing reactions.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dried-out skin report the serum did not worsen dryness and one calls it a game changer for super dry skin, unlike other vitamin C serums that dried her face out.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one with inflammation and mild acne, report reduced inflammation, faded scarring, and a more even tone with no sensitivity issues.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive or acne-prone-and-sensitive report brightening and fading dark spots without breakouts, though one still avoids the product over the Yellow 6 dye.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 50s to mid-70s report firmer, brighter, more even-toned and smoother skin, with some noting reduced fine lines and no new wrinkles.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal skin, including one with sun damage, report faded brown spots and firmer, hydrated skin after regular use.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report firmer skin, reduced fine lines, and a more youthful look; one reviewer explicitly says she is too young to be concerned about fine lines, so this benefit is reported mainly by older users.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the serum feels hydrating and improves softness without drying out skin, and one with severe dryness from a prescription retinoid found it kept skin from being too dry; no reviewer reports increased dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with facial inflammation reports her skin looked less inflamed throughout the day after use; this concern is otherwise rarely mentioned.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe skin adapting over time and note the product did not irritate or react badly even on sensitive or reactive skin, though one reviewer needed an adjustment period before it felt comfortable.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, sun damage marks, and acne scarring within days to weeks; one reviewer says it evened tone but did not specifically fade her dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in acne scarring; one reviewer explicitly states the serum caused her to break out after six weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the serum as non-greasy and lightweight, including a reviewer with normal/combo oily skin who had no adverse reaction; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Concern over expired stock from retailer

extraits.texte: I've been using it for about 6 weeks now and although it feels great going on, it is causing me to breakout. It's too bad; I was hopeful.

I have normal/combo oily skin. Mid-30s and acne-prone so I need to be careful with new products. I've had to get rid of products after two uses due to reactions. But NOT THIS ONE! I had a lot of acne scaring on my cheeks from hormone fluctuations in the last few years. After one bottle of this Vit C, those dark spots have drastically decreased. My skin looks nearly smooth and consistent again. This plus my other skin care products helped my face in general clear up. Tbh i got this first bottle free in an Ulta gift but I think it may be a permanent addition to my skincare routine.

I have combination skin with a lot of inflammation, mild acne, and both light and dark scarring. My skin isn't sensitive but I usually don't notice much difference when I use different products. I was SO SHOCKED at how this made my skin look and feel. It is definitely sticky and has a strong orange scent but the scent fades and I just wait for it to absorb into my skin before I continue on in my skincare routine. Adding moisturizer on top of it immediately takes away the stickiness. My skin was GLOWING all day after using this. It looks more even-toned and less inflammed throughout the day. I've used it for a few days and each day it looks like this . HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

This serum is soooo goood! I have acne prone and sensitive skin so trying to find the right vitamin c serum that doesn't break me out is so difficult. But this serum takes the cake ive seen a huge difference all of my dark spots are fading and its not breaking me out 10/10!!!!
I'm 59 and used the serum twice a day for two weeks. My skin tone is much brighter, firmer, and even as well as looking more dewy.

I was having severe hormonal acne & my curolgist put me on trinotin. Everyone knows that makes your skin dry. This serum helped my acne go down so much along with helping my skin not be so dry from the medication.
I love this product. I was dealing with super dry skin on my face and this serum has been a game changer. I use it daily and receive compliments on my fresh face look!
